label: Nose size

provenance.source: species-head-spec.md section 3.1 #5 (anchor ratios sections 2/3.2, preset formula section 3.0)

range.endpoint_anchor: nose width / muzzle width: 0.55 = 0 (neutral base); span 0.30 -> -100 = 0.25, +100 = 0.85 (preset value = 100 x (species ratio - 0.55) / 0.30)

region.mask_rule: nose tip swell on the rostrum block; bone layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Nose leather scale - the geometry swell at the tip, as nose width over muzzle width. The leather's SHAPE is a discrete part variant (nose_canid / nose_felid, spec section 3.4); this slider only scales the tip. A bone-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
